title: Plans
snippet:
# Free: $0
For individuals getting started. Free is for one person, so there's no shared workspace.
- Unlimited meetings, up to 45 minutes each
- 30-day meeting history: older meetings are locked and unlock when you upgrade
- 5 manual uploads in total, each under 45 minutes
- AI notes and action items, real-time notes and live transcripts, clip creation
- Record with the bot, or without one using the desktop app
- Personal API and webhooks, Zapier, and Claude and ChatGPT through basic MCP
# Pro: $15 per month billed yearly, or $19 monthly
For individuals who've outgrown Free. Pro is also for one person.
- Unlimited meetings, up to 4 hours each
- Unlimited meeting history
- Unlimited uploads and imports, each under 3 hours
- Custom AI prompts and note templates, custom vocabulary
- No watermark
# Business: $29 per seat per month billed yearly, or $39 monthly
For companies sharing meeting memory and AI. Minimum 2 seats.
- Shared company workspace with admin controls, teams, and team libraries with custom recording and sharing rules
- Free Lite seats: invite teammates to watch, comment and clip
- Unlimited meetings up to 8 hours each; unlimited uploads, each under 3 hours
- Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce and Aircall, including CRM field autofill
- Conversation intelligence: AI coaching, trackers and talk-time metrics
- Custom AI follow-up emails
- Advanced MCP for Claude and ChatGPT; workspace API and webhooks. Learn more about Grain's MCP [here](https://support.grain.com/en/articles/14811968-how-to-use-the-grain-mcp-server).
- Recording consent, sensitive meeting detection and data retention policies
- Free data migration from other AI notetakers

title: Grain API
snippet:
The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events from Grain programmatically. Use it to build custom integrations, sync data to internal systems, or automate workflows that go beyond what Grain's built-in integrations support.

**Personal Access Token (PAT)**: grants access on behalf of a single user. The token has the same permissions as the user who generated it. Best for personal automations or testing. Available on every plan, including Free. Click [here](https://grain.com/app/settings/account/integrations/personal_api) to generate a PAT.
**Workspace Access Token (WAT)**: grants access to all data in the workspace, regardless of which user owns it. Use this for server-side integrations where you need workspace-wide access. Requires admin access to generate and is available on Business and Enterprise plans. Click [here](https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api) to generate a WAT.

The API allows 300 requests per minute per token. Requests beyond this limit return a `429 Too Many Requests` response. Each response includes rate limit headers so you can track remaining capacity.

**Do I need a specific Grain plan to use the API?** Not for personal API access, which is available on every plan, including Free. Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate.
